name: Hasumi Aki
source: He's smart and good at sports, but he's also quiet, has strong likes and dislikes regarding people, and does things at his own pace. He prefers to act alone and often sneaks out of class to listen to music on the roof or in the courtyard. He always wears headphones and only takes them off in front of people he's close to.
